text: Yes, Hansen recorded tree-cover loss within the property in 2021, totaling **81.3 hectares** (2.23% of the asset). The loss was corroborated by JRC data, which confirmed 98% of the area as forested in 2020. The affected area consisted mostly of planted *Pinus elliottii* and *Pinus taeda* (68.1 ha), with no native forest impacted. Additionally, 37.3 ha of loss occurred in small patches under 0.5 ha, which Hansen excluded from the event count.
